label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 071 ]

blocks.text: Tests were carried out to study the effects of laughter on the body. People watched funny movies, while doctors checked their heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, and muscles. It was found that laughter has similar effects to physical exercise. It increases blood pressure and the rate of breathing, and it also works several groups of muscles in the face, the stomach, and even the feet.

readingSentences.english: Tests were carried out to study the effects of laughter on the body.
readingSentences.korean: 웃음이 몸에 미치는 영향을 연구하기 위해 실험이 이루어졌다.

readingSentences.english: People watched funny movies, while doctors checked their heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, and muscles.
readingSentences.korean: 사람들이 재미있는 영화를 보는 동안 의사들은 그들의 심박수, 혈압, 호흡, 근육을 확인했다.

readingSentences.english: It was found that laughter has similar effects to physical exercise.
readingSentences.korean: 웃음이 신체 운동과 비슷한 효과를 낸다는 것이 밝혀졌다.

readingSentences.english: It increases blood pressure and the rate of breathing, and it also works several groups of muscles in the face, the stomach, and even the feet.
readingSentences.korean: 웃음은 혈압과 호흡수를 높이고, 얼굴과 배, 심지어 발의 여러 근육도 움직이게 한다.
